description: Óbitos por acidentes e desastres devido a eventos geodinâmicos is a series of datasets listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Este produto apresenta o indicador ?número de óbitos? decorrentes de acidentes e desastres devido a eventos geodinâmicos em atendimentos emergenciais da Operação Verão (dezembro a março) no período de 2000 a 2010 no Estado de São Paulo. No mapa este indicador é representado em classes de frequência por município. Coverage: Brasil. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. Its tags are desastres, naturais, risco, geológico, obito. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
